problem: The sentence 'A fan blade, a wing section and a wire loop all have a natural circulation' treats circulation as a property of a solid object. Circulation is a line integral of a vector field around a closed curve, not something an object possesses by itself.
fix: Say instead: 'Aerodynamicists compute circulation around a wing section, and electrical engineers compute the line integral of the electric field around a circuit loop.'
